description: Central Province - Announced that Mrs. Anoma Senarath Polwatta is removed from the Post of Chairman/Member of the Board of Directors of Central Provincial Passenger Transport Services Authority with effect from 03.11.2015
reasoning: This gazette names a specific individual (Mrs. Anoma Senarath Polwatta) and details the post from which she is being removed (Chairman/Member of the Board of Directors). It also names the appointing minister (Ediriweera Weerawardena) and provides his detailed ministerial portfolios (Minister of Road Development, Transport, Power and Energy and Housing and Construction). This combination of a named individual and detailed government responsibilities/portfolios meets the criteria for a Hybrid Gazette (Type 3).
